# SpikeEncodingLatency

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The temporal delay introduced during the conversion of image pixels to spike events, which impacts the real-time responsiveness of SNN inference. Minimizing this latency is essential for high-performance neuromorphic systems in time-critical applications, a core focus of iNEST.
